notes: The candidate starts with three adapter-configured application attributes published on an ordinary object class. After unpublishing one attribute, the requester issues a fresh standard MIM publication query and checks the exact current object-class attribute list: the two remaining adapter-configured application attributes plus inherited HLAprivilegeToDeleteObject defined by the 1516.2-2025 MIM. No DDM services or implementation-specific assumptions are used.

requirements.statement: The federate unpublishes one selected object-class attribute with the standard Unpublish Object Class Attributes service. A subsequent publication query reflects the resulting current declaration state.

The subsequent standard MIM object-class publication report contains exactly the remaining two adapter-configured application attributes and inherited HLAprivilegeToDeleteObject, and excludes the unpublished application attribute.
